function.name: give_up
function.arguments: {"reason": "The red cube was never grasped and the bowl is empty; repeated closes met above or beside the cube and the final push did not move it. No calls remain to retry and place it.", "hindsight": "Gripper latch toggles schedule about 79 control steps with full convergence; without a toggle only 1 to 4 steps run. The wrist camera is offset and tilted so the cube appears far from the jaw even when nearly below it; use the fixed views for centering. Grasping a 2.5cm cube on z=0.80 needs the eef near z=0.85."}
